header.title: Why do buyers hesitate to forward AI answers to legal?

excerpt.text: Reviewers said they would forward an answer when they could
without asking the author for help.
Legal asked which policy version the answer relied on and who had approved it.
current on the day the answer was given
Retention and reviewer access were raised before model quality in the review.
A shared answer needs a stable passage link that survives forwarding.

streamContinuation: how long that passage is kept. It should not promise that a cited answer is correct; it should promise that a reviewer can test it.

segments.text: Seven of nine teams said an answer is only forwardable if the reviewer can open the document behind it
. Legal wants to know which version of a policy was read
still current when the answer was written
The hesitation is rarely about the model. Reviewers ask who can see the source
, how long the passage is kept, and whether the link still works when the answer is forwarded outside the team

blocks.text: I can defend a number if I can open the page it came from.

answer.heading: Buyers forward answers they can inspect.
